fields.statement: QA claude-code-dc3d533e at 99e340d22 (cycle 2), hands-on with the built binary driving real ship-change runs (rhiza run start/approve --foreground) in a scratch Rhiza root with a bare origin and fake gh, rex and claude on PATH: with RHIZA_TEST_NOW/SEED set, the builder and verifier sessions (a6fe1895-5d81-... and a6fe1895-5d86-...) share the 8-hex prefix that broke cycle 1; they got distinct actors claude-code-a6fe1895 and claude-code-a6fe1895-N, build/check passed, the run succeeded, and rhiza check on the result printed ok with no duplicate handle. Also go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run RecordAgentActor passes, and the 19 run-* testscripts cycle 1 found red (run-ship-change, run-ship-model-conflict, run-ship-conflict-fix, run-ship-land-conflict, ...) all pass.

QA claude-code-dc3d533e at 99e340d22 (cycle 2), hands-on with the built binary driving real ship-change runs (rhiza run start/approve --foreground) in a scratch Rhiza root with a bare origin and fake gh, rex and claude on PATH: with a head build (SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA) that refuses the first land with exit 3 'cannot land change set X: node N changed' after main moved feature.txt, land failed with exit 3 reporting the conflict and leaving the merge for the fixer, land-main-conflict-triage passed to conflict-fix (not conflict-fix-landed), one fixer session, land visit 2 passed and the change set landed. With 'it depends on Y (draft)' instead, the run fails with no fixer (run-ship-land-conflict case 2 passes). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipLand passes.

QA claude-code-dc3d533e at 99e340d22 (cycle 2), hands-on with the built binary driving real ship-change runs (rhiza run start/approve --foreground) in a scratch Rhiza root with a bare origin and fake gh, rex and claude on PATH: with fake rex failing its first 2 tab opens ('rex: server not answering'), the builder's tab opened on the third try and the run went on to ship; with 4 failures the run failed at build/build naming 'rex: server not answering (after 3 retries)'. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run SessionRunRexRetry passes.

QA claude-code-dc3d533e at 99e340d22 (cycle 2), hands-on with the built binary driving real ship-change runs (rhiza run start/approve --foreground) in a scratch Rhiza root with a bare origin and fake gh, rex and claude on PATH: gh pr create failing twice with 'HTTP 502: Bad Gateway' then succeeding: open-pr passed after 3 pr create calls; failing 4 times: open-pr failed after 4 calls naming the 502 '(after 3 retries)'; 'HTTP 422: Validation Failed': open-pr failed after 1 call (not retried). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipGHRetry passes.

QA claude-code-dc3d533e at 99e340d22 (cycle 2), hands-on with the built binary driving real ship-change runs (rhiza run start/approve --foreground) in a scratch Rhiza root with a bare origin and fake gh, rex and claude on PATH: gh pr merge failing with 'the base branch policy prohibits the merge': the run stopped once at merge with detail 'GitHub refused to merge pull request #7: ... the base branch policy prohibits the merge', one pr merge call, gate-rebase-merge visited once (before merge only). Merge refused once with 'the head branch is not up to date with the base branch': merge went to gate-rebase-merge visit 2, rebase-merge, and merged on visit 2; run succeeded. go test ./internal/api -run ShipMergeRefused and ./internal/workflow -run ShipChange pass.

QA claude-code-dc3d533e at 99e340d22 (cycle 2), hands-on with the built binary driving real ship-change runs (rhiza run start/approve --foreground) in a scratch Rhiza root with a bare origin and fake gh, rex and claude on PATH: the builder pushed its branch then a separate clone pushed 'Earlier push' (a new file) to origin's cs/ship-it: open-pr merged it ('Merge origin/cs/ship-it into cs/ship-it'), pushed, origin's history kept the Earlier push commit, no force push, and the run reached merge. With the origin commit conflicting with a later local commit on feature.txt, open-pr failed exit 3 with 'origin's cs/ship-it has commits that conflict with ...: 659e515 Earlier push; reconcile them before shipping', no MERGE_HEAD left, origin unchanged. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipPushDiverged passes.
